截胡主角机缘（截胡主角机缘（第22页）“忠义侯？”“正是晚辈。”“老夫听说过你。”赵无极慢悠悠地开口，声音沙哑，“陛下的宠臣，名声不太好。”汪海笑了笑，不以为意：“赵老说的是，晚辈确实名声不佳。”贪花好色、心狠手辣、谄媚逢迎……这些评价他听得多了，多一个不多，少一个不少。赵无极似乎没想到他会这么坦然地承认，微微一愣，随即笑了起来，枯瘦的脸上褶皱堆叠，像一朵风干的菊花。“有意思，你这娃娃倒是不虚伪。”“赵老谬赞。”赵无极摇了摇头，目光落回汪海袖口，眼中闪过一丝精光。“那东西，你已经看了？”汪海心头一凛，知道瞒不过这位深不可测的老人，索性大大方方地将金纸从袖中取出。“晚辈正打算看。”赵无极接过金纸，枯瘦的手指在纸面上轻轻摩挲，浑浊的眼中流露出一丝追忆之色。“这门功法，在藏经阁里藏了千年。”千年？汪海挑了挑眉。“太祖皇帝当年横扫六合，定鼎天下，搜罗了无数功法秘籍存入此阁。唯独这一门，他没有收录进名录，而是随手夹在了那本书里。”赵无极抬头看向汪海，目光深邃，“太祖曾言，此功法太过逆天，不宜现世。若有缘人得之，便是天意。”“太祖还说，修炼此功法需至阳体质，且必须至纯至净，不得掺杂半点阴柔，若非如此，轻则走火入魔，重则经脉尽断而亡。”赵无极将金纸递回给汪海，浑浊的眼中带着几分审视。“老夫观你体内阳气炽烈如大日当空，确实是至阳体质，你若能将此法练至第六层，可再来藏经阁寻我。”话音落下，人已消失在楼梯拐角处。汪海目送他的背影离去，这才收回目光，低头看向手中的金纸。“学习。”汪海毫不犹豫地选择了是。金纸猛地爆发出刺目的金光，化作无数金色符文顺着他的手掌涌入体内，如百川归海，直冲丹田。轰！脑海中仿佛有惊雷炸响。一篇玄奥的功法口诀如烙印般刻入记忆深处，每一个字都散发着炽烈的金光，在识海中熠熠生辉。玄阳不死功，共分九层。第一层，铜皮铁骨，肉身强度翻倍。第二层，脏腑如钢，内腑韧性大增，可承受更强冲击。第三层，断肢重生，失去的肢体可在短时间内重新长出。第四层，本源固化，根基稳固，不易被外力摧毁。第五层，气血如海，气血充盈到极致，体力近乎无穷。第六层，滴血重生，只要有一滴精血尚存，便可重塑肉身。第七层，元神不灭，即便肉身被毁，只要一丝元神尚存，便可重塑肉身。第八层，不死之身，常规手段无法杀死，需以特殊秘法或至宝镇压。第九层，永恒不灭，与天地同寿，真正的不死不灭。……汪海倒吸一口凉气。神阶上品！滴血重生、元神不灭、不死之身、永恒不灭……这些特性已经超出了寻常功法的范畴，更像是某种法则的体现。难怪太祖皇帝说它不宜现世。……

"Jie Hu Protagonist Opportunity" (Jie Hu Protagonist Opportunity (Page 22) "Marquis Zhongyi?" "It is the junior." "I have heard of you." Zhao Wuji spoke slowly, his voice hoarse, "His Majesty's favorite minister, his reputation is not good. That's great." Wang Hai smiled and didn't take it seriously: "What Mr. Zhao said is that juniors do have a bad reputation. "They are lustful, ruthless, and flattering... He has heard these comments many times. One more is not more, and one is less. Quite a few. Zhao Wuji seemed not to expect that he would admit it so frankly. He was stunned for a moment, and then he laughed, with wrinkles on his skinny face, like a dried chrysanthemum. "Interesting, you are not hypocritical." "Zhao Laomi praised it." Zhao Wuji shook his head, looking back at Wang Hai's sleeves, with a glimmer of light in his eyes. "Have you seen that thing?" Wang Hai felt a chill in his heart, knowing that he couldn't hide it from this unfathomable person. The old man simply took out the gold paper from his sleeve. "Junior is about to take a look." Zhao Wuji took the gold paper and gently rubbed it with his thin fingers, with a trace of reminiscence in his turbid eyes. " This technique has been hidden in the Sutra Pavilion for thousands of years. "Thousands of years?" Wang Hai raised his eyebrows. "Emperor Taizu swept across the world and collected countless secrets of techniques and stored them in this pavilion. It was entered in the directory, but it was tucked into the book. "Zhao Wuji looked up at Wang Hai with a deep look, "Taizu once said that this technique is too unfavorable to be found in this world. It is God's will." Taizu also said that practicing this technique requires an extremely yang constitution, and it must be extremely pure, with no trace of yin. If not, it could lead to a demonic state at worst, or death due to severed meridians." Zhao Wuji handed the gold paper back to Wang Hai. There was a hint of scrutiny in his turbid eyes. "I see that the yang energy in your body is as blazing as the sun in the sky. You are indeed a Yang physique. If you can practice this method to the sixth level, you can come to the Sutra Pavilion to find me again." After the words fell, Wang Hai watched his back disappear, and then he looked back and looked down at the gold paper in his hand. "Study." Wang Hai chose yes without hesitation. Countless golden runes poured into his body like rivers returning to the sea, and boom! There seemed to be a thunderous explosion in his mind, and a mysterious skill formula was engraved into the depths of his memory. The characters are all emitting blazing golden light, shining brightly in the sea of consciousness. The Xuanyang Immortality Skill is divided into nine layers. The first layer is copper skin and iron bones, and the physical strength is doubled. The second layer is like steel, and the internal organs are tougher and can withstand more energy. Strong impact. The third level, the lost limbs can be regenerated in a short time. The fourth level, the origin is solid, the foundation is stable, and it is not easily destroyed by external forces. The fifth level, the energy and blood are filled to the extreme, and the physical strength is almost infinite. The sixth level, as long as there is a drop of blood, the physical body can be rebuilt. The seventh level, the soul is immortal, even if the physical body is destroyed, as long as the soul is still alive, the physical body can be rebuilt. The eighth level, the immortal body, cannot be killed by conventional methods, and must be suppressed by special secret methods or treasures. The ninth level, eternal immortality, living as long as the heaven and earth, true immortality. ...Wang Hai took a breath. Reborn with blood, immortal soul, eternal immortality... These characteristics are beyond the scope of ordinary skills. No wonder Emperor Taizu said it is not suitable for the world.
